title: Grain Clerk Training Note: Where the Hold Period on a Ticket Runs From
content:
The hold period on tickets standing against a contract under Grain Marketing Contracts is counted in calendar days up to the day the amendment is registered, and where it runs from is read off the ledger.

**First.** Where the ledger shows the last load posted later than the day it was received, the hold runs from the day the last load was posted to the ledger, since grain is not held to the member's account until it is on the books.

**Second.** Where the last load was received before the first day of the contract's delivery window, the hold runs from the first day of that window.

**Third.** Where neither of those holds, the hold runs from the day the last load was received.

## The three cases in one view

| The last load posted later than the day it was received | The last load received before the first day of the delivery window | The hold runs from |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Either way | the day the last load was posted |
| No | Yes | the first day of the delivery window |
| No | No | the day the last load was received |

## Illustration on hypothetical records

A ledger shows the last load received on the third of a month and posted on the seventh: the hold runs from the seventh, and the day of receipt does not govern. Where receipt and posting fall on the same day, and that day is a fortnight before the delivery window opened, the hold runs from the first day of the window. Where receipt and posting fall on the same day inside the window, the hold runs from that day.
